newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's yields end higher in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's yields end higher in cautious trading.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds finished higher on Tuesday as investors stood on the sidelines amid depressed buying sentiment, brokers said.
They said institutional buying interest has disappeared with shortage in liquidity.
Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds closed up on Tuesday as investors clung to the sidelines amid bearish buying sentiment, brokers said.
They said institutional buying interest has died out with shortage in liquidity.
New issues were relatively large at 116 billion won, pressuring the market.
Three-month CD yields also rose in similar trading pattern, brokers said.
